scope: Immutable input-independent frontend coefficients, not host preprocessing

dft: 512 FP32 roots of unity, exact quarter-turn axes; 257x512 tables indexed by (frequency*sample)%512
storage: Compact 512-root tables; host expands input-independent coefficient matrix using integer phase indices, never audio
